verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 78.5 (-1.6% in a day) and momentum is 49: prices are steady. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,000 and 86s 4,700. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-18T01:58:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell João Félix 84 Team of the week after its 29% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 79,000 coins. Now 83,500. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 29.5% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 12 of 19 so far, averaging +9.1% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Trey Nyoni 86 Star Performer after its 27% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 634,000 coins. Now 660,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 27.1% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 3 of 8 so far, averaging -0.8% after tax. It was paused after losing calls, so this is a low-confidence retest. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-19T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,000 (0.95 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,700 (1.15 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,200 (1.13 coins per Item Score point), 88s 10,000 (1.20 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Louisa Necib and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Louisa Necib 87 Base Hero -28.1%; Hidetoshi Nakata 87 Base Hero -23.9%; João Félix 84 Team of the week -23.4%; Ludovic Giuly 86 Base Hero -23.3%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Ethan Nwaneri SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 20.6K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
